result.brief: 提出以场景锚定物体的3D重建渲染作为尺度感知的相机控制信号，结合H-Concat时序对齐的视频扩散模型，并蒸馏为流式少步自回归生成器实现实时相机控制。
result.reason: Camera-controlled video diffusion with anchor-object 3D rendering as camera signal, H-Concat temporal alignment, and streaming few-step AR distillation; directly a controllable video generation contribution.
